ca_volume_lab.name: A volume can become a room
ca_volume_lab.description: A 13 cubed, synchronous, 26-neighbour cellular automaton with three seeds and two authored rules. Compare solid, boundary-frame and faceted-shell architecture, with collision following the chosen material. Sine changes birth conditions; bending and an explicit inspection cut leave the cellular state intact. This is a standalone experiment, not a trained generative model.
ca_volume_lab.qfep_connection: Inspect how seed, survival conditions and material mapping admit different bodies. The shell aperture policy is an explicit architectural choice; cellular complexity alone does not establish body access or a numerical entropy threshold.
interactions: Apply sine to the rule or bend coordinates
